shortDescription: The Shangai Composite Index rose 5 points or 0.12 percent on Tuesday to close at 3955 points.Leading the gains are Yonyou Soft (3.45%), BAIC BluePark (2.80%) and Shanghai Electric (2.76%).Top losers were Greenland Holdings (-4.38%), Avic Aviation Engine (-2.27%) and Jiangsu Lianyungang (-2.21%).
